title: ProcessMind: LLM Multi-Agent Extraction + Sound Process Mining for Automated BPMN Reconstruction
description: ProcessMind is a research framework that fuses heterogeneous process knowledge sources (unstructured SOP text and structured event logs) into valid, conformance-checked BPMN 2.0 models. It implements five extractor configurations (deterministic rule parser E1, single-shot LLM E2, LLM with self-correction E3, DFG discovery E4, and a sound-by-construction Inductive Miner E6) evaluated under one identical-measures harness. Includes 162-test suite, 4-SOP/7-log corpus, and one-command reproducible evaluation.
